analysis:
Goyal set the target on 31 March 2023 while unveiling the Foreign Trade Policy 2023, when total exports were about US$765 billion.

Government and Commerce Ministry communications in 2026 cite total exports of about US$863 billion in FY2025-26 and state that the US$2 trillion target for 2030-31 remains on track.

The target is a projection rather than a recorded outcome. With the deadline in 2030-31 it is not yet due, so it is recorded as in progress. Export outcomes depend on global demand, exchange rates and trade agreements.
